top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and incretin therapy is a mature, independently confirmed discovery with large randomized outcome trials, and all six members agree on the Drucker and Holst core. P001 rests the third seat on Knudsen's documented, undisputed step from a peptide with a half-life of minutes to once-daily and once-weekly agonists, whereas P002 depends on Mojsov's priority against the Habener group, which cannot be settled from the supplied material. P002 is a close second because it shares the core and differs in one seat, and it would rank first if the primary record showed her identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) form was distinct and decisive. Either is far better than no award.
